newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's Cesp to securitize revenues.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's Cesp to securitize revenues.

text.p: Sao Paulo state power company Cesp plans to securitize 3.5 billion reais ($3.37 billion) in future privatization revenues, said an official at the state's Energy Secretariat.

Under the plan, Cesp will issue debentures totalling 3.5 billion reais, all of which will be acquired by Brazil's National Development Bank (BNDES), said Ricardo Lima, an official at the secretariat who advises investors on the state's privatization plan.

He said Cesp would issue in January 700 million reais ($674 million) in debentures backed by future privatization revenues of its power company Companhia Paulista de Forca e Luz (CPFL), expected to be sold in the first half of 1997.
The launch of the remaining 2.8 billion reais in debentures has not been defined yet, he said.
"By anticipating privatization revenues, Cesp plans to pay off part of its debt to Eletrobras ," he said.
Cesp has a total debt of 11.4 billion reais.
